instruction.text: Harry recherchiert im Internet zu den Olympischen Spielen. Schaue dir das Video an und höre aufmerksam zu.

<voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>mouse-click</voice>

The Summer Olympic Games are an event that takes place every four years. The first Summer Olympics were held in Athens, Greece in 1896. The most popular sports in the competition are athletics, aquatics and gymnastics.
<voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>mouse-click</voice>
<voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>mouse-click</voice>
The Summer Olympic Games took place in London in 1908, 1948 and 2012. London was the first city to host the Summer Olympic Games three times.
<voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>mouse-click</voice>
<voice voiceLang='de' voice='custom'>mouse-click</voice>
The Paralympics are similar to the Olympic Games. However, the athletes competing all have disabilities. The Paralympics are held right after the Olympics. The first Paralympics were held in 1948.
